Complete [[Imperial Sanctum]].

== Quest information ==
=== Objectives ===
* Defeat [[Shiro]].
* *BONUS* Complete the mission in under 2.5 minutes (3 minutes in [[Hard Mode]]).
* *BONUS* Complete the mission in Hard Mode.
* See [[Zehnchu]] <nowiki>[</nowiki>[[Zaishen]] Challenge] for your reward.

=== Reward ===
* 5,000 [[Experience]]
* 1,000 [[Gold]]
* Complete the Base Objective for 30 [[Copper Zaishen Coin|Zaishen Copper Coin]]s.
* Complete the first *BONUS* Objective for an additional 45 Zaishen Copper Coins.
* Complete the second *BONUS* Objective for an additional 75 Zaishen Copper Coins.

== Walkthrough ==
As per the [[Imperial Sanctum#Walkthrough|Imperial Sanctum]] mission.
